description_for_human: SANRI is an AI-powered numerology and symbolic analysis platform. Analyze names, calculate life paths, decode words, and explore collective consciousness.
description_for_model: SANRI provides numerology analysis (Pythagorean system), symbolic text analysis, name frequency calculation, life path computation, and Matrix Role reading. Use it for: name numerology, word frequency analysis, symbolic interpretation of events and texts, archetype identification. API base: https://sanri-api-production-4a7b.up.railway.app. Endpoints: POST /sanri/analyze (text analysis), POST /sanri/name (name + optional birth date analysis), GET /sanri/info (capabilities), POST /matrix-rol (full Matrix Role).
